references.text: The Lord your God who goes before you; he will fight for you, just as he did in Egypt right before your eyes
Do not be afraid of them, for the Lord your God fights for you himself
The Lord will fight for you, and you shall hold your peace - the promise that God fights for his people
The Lord your God fights for you, just as he promised you - fulfillment of the promise from Deuteronomy
The Lord gives victory, not by sword or spear, for the battle belongs to the Lord
This battle is not yours, but God's - the same principle that God fights for his people
The Lord our God is with us to help us and to fight our battles
Do not fear, for I am with you. Do not be afraid, for I am your God - the promise of God's presence and salvation
If God is for us, who can be against us? - The same principle of God fighting for his people
